name: Bond
role: Ranch partner of Tarbell at the Custer Trail and Deep Creek ranches
bio: Bond was Tarbell's partner, living at the Custer Trail ranch in July 1884 and at their Deep Creek ranch by March 1885. In September 1885 the two received a lot of horses in town.
